title: job view operator diagnostics: health first, signal chip second

restarts.backend_restarted_by: the operator or something else, between Stage 5ZD and 5ZE
restarts.why: app.run(..., use_reloader=False) - the process will not pick up new code
restarts.why_not_run_here: the stage permits a backend restart only if needed for UI verification, and it was not: the UI was verified in a real chromium against a freshly imported app inside the test process. Leaving it to the operator also keeps today's remaining Ro 4 window (Swing 14:05 ET) undisturbed

measured_from: the real render path in realtime.js
part_a_audit.key_finding: the evidence list is ALWAYS empty for a shadow slot - it is built from trade and protection events, and a shadow slot emits none

matrix.field: runtime refusal (freshness, live frame, splice, bar provider, too late, stale, overlap)
matrix.where: nowhere on the job at all
nowhere - a number with nothing to judge it against
day-level counts in the Track 1 panel only
Track 1 panel, day and sleeve level
Track 1 panel, present/absent for the day

health_fields_added: explicit 'no checkpoint or book write expected in shadow'

chip.location: inside the existing job row, on its own line below the job name and summary, grid-column 1 / -1

intentionally_hidden_until_debug.rendered_by: nothing - there is no code path in the page that reads it
intentionally_hidden_until_debug.why: after Stage 5ZD every sleeve rule comes back not_exposed_by_sleeve, so a mapped list would be thirty human names with no numbers beside them - a longer way of saying nothing, burying the two lines that carry information
intentionally_hidden_until_debug.replaced_by_one_sentence: Detailed setup measurements are not exposed yet.

no_duplication.rule: REFUSED / MISSED / NO DIAGNOSTICS point at Operational rather than repeating the runtime evidence
no_duplication.tested: the refusal sentence appears exactly once in the expanded row

label_mapper.unmapped_falls_back_to: the raw name, so a gap looks wrong on the page

mutations_that_found_my_tests_wrong.what: a chip given min-width 900px on a 380px screen
mutations_that_found_my_tests_wrong.first_test: document.scrollWidth - the chip is in a scrolling container, so the page never scrolled
mutations_that_found_my_tests_wrong.second_test: the project's element-level clipping detector - which deliberately allows wide content inside a scrolling ancestor
mutations_that_found_my_tests_wrong.the_actual_claim: the chip does not widen its ROW
mutations_that_found_my_tests_wrong.now: measures the chip's bounding box against its row's

mutations_that_found_my_tests_wrong.what: a non-strategy job gets a chip, in the browser
mutations_that_found_my_tests_wrong.why: the DOM fixture builds its stub payload directly and never calls the patched backend function, so a Python patch could not reach chromium
mutations_that_found_my_tests_wrong.now: mutated in the JS the browser actually loads

stage_5zd_tests_updated.why: they pinned the UI this stage deliberately replaced: the sentence in the collapsed row, the rule grid, the per-sleeve panel row, and the signal shape before chip/operator/debug existed
stage_5zd_tests_updated.how: rewritten to assert the same intent against the new rendering, not deleted
